Import from Google Keep and Obsidian.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Keep / Obsidian import.** Re-importing skips what's already there, and a big import resumes where it stopped.

### 🚀 Features
- Edit your username, name and email.
- New avatars and a free-framing picture cropper.
- App-wide progress feedback; the note grid reflows smoothly on resize.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Opening a note no longer re-saves it.
- One-click delete; your manual note order sticks.
- Imported notes keep their original dates on Linux.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.8...v0.1.9](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9)
